correctness.rationale: Invariance of equal pairs and deterministic erosion of intervening alternating runs prove tau=floor(D/2), including checkerboard exception. The even-parity edge map is two-to-one and each allowed circular edge word gives exactly two closed parity-register walks, yielding the exact trace census. Rare-run indicator factorial moments give the nonvacuous Poisson window along length-and-time subsequences (e.g., n_j=floor(8 lambda 4^j), t_j=j); positive/negative tail bounds yield E[tau]=(log2 n)/2+O(1). All hypotheses, parity boundaries, and time-zero periodic convention accounted for. An independent simulator checked 8,184 n=3..12 states, 55 exact trace tests, and the sharp 2n maximum for 10 sizes; experiments supplement the proof, not prove all sizes.
